### The Remedy for Sin’s Deceitfulness
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/the-remedy-for-sins-deceitfulness
Passage: Hebrews 3:12-13
Points:
- Scripture warns against following the exodus generation's unbelief by abandoning Christ.
- The opportunity to repent and trust in Jesus will not last forever.
- Christians should respond to God immediately rather than presuming on tomorrow.
- Mutual daily encouragement is a means God uses to guard believers from being hardened by sin.

### The Encourager
Author: Kelly McFadden
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/homeword/homeword-dec-11-2007-11561517.html
Passage: Hebrews 3:13
Points:
- Believers are strengthened and inspired when they know others are actively cheering them on.
- Consistent fellowship and encouragement help Christians maintain a resilient faith.
- Having supportive believers walking alongside us provides accountability that guards against stumbling into sin.
- God never intended for the Christian walk to be pursued in isolation.
